original_forecast.resolution_rule: Up-event succeeds if the official/index-provider or consistently sourced S&P 500 close on 2026-08-13 exceeds the 2026-08-12 close of 7,748.50. Resolve the point and 80% interval against the same close source.
rationale: Contained CPI, a lower post-CPI yield response, fresh tight HY spreads, and resilient breadth give H001 a modest lead.
July PPI is due before the Aug. 13 open and the oil/inflation channel remains active, so the forecast stays near-neutral rather than extrapolating the CPI-day rise.
Recent AI-related earnings support the index but are sufficiently concentrated that they should not be treated as a broad macro signal.
surprising_if: PPI is benign and the 10-year yield does not rise materially, yet SPX falls more than 1.5% without another identifiable shock.
SPX closes outside the stated 80% interval.

resolution.source: Reuters, 2026-08-13 U.S. market close: S&P 500 closed at 7,798.99, up 0.65%.
resolution.audit_note: Forecast content above is preserved verbatim. The up-event resolved true and the 80% interval covered, but the point estimate missed by 43.99 points and lost to the precommitted recent-trend benchmark while beating no-change. This forecast was scored before any post-Aug. 12 evidence was used for model revision.
